name: aclfe/inertia
reading_scope: Bounded code reading; no full audit/build/benchmark
finding: Particle-pair overlap projection splits correction by inverse mass and edits Verlet previous positions. Approaching normal displacement is removed; tangential relative displacement is scaled by friction without a normal-load Coulomb cap in this function. Coincident particles below squared distance 1e-12 are skipped.

name: zalo/TetSim
reading_scope: Bounded code reading; no full audit/build/benchmark
finding: Tetrahedral deformation gradient drives separate Frobenius-norm and determinant projections. Volumetric target includes volCompliance/devCompliance; compliance scales by inverse rest volume and dt^-2. applyToElem has no persistent lambda; degenerate F and zero devCompliance require validation.

name: hanbollar/Position-Based-Dynamics
reading_scope: Bounded code reading; no full audit/build/benchmark
finding: Ground constraints are generated for negative signed plane distance; sphere path is commented out. Velocity update computes a local reflected velo but only adds friction to v.row: the local normal reflection is not assigned back in the viewed function. Tangential damping has no Coulomb budget here.

name: MelonWithGlasses/Melon3D
reading_scope: Bounded code reading; no full audit/build/benchmark
finding: Rigid-contact velocity pass computes effective tangent mass and Coulomb impulse budget mu*lambdaN/h. Low-speed incoherent slip deliberately uses full stopping impulse even beyond that budget. Restitution uses pre-substep normal speed and gravity-dependent threshold. These are explicit game heuristics, not validated tissue contact.

name: geoelements/diffmpm
reading_scope: Bounded code reading; no full audit/build/benchmark
finding: Read MPM orchestration: nodal kinematics, pre-stress, forces, particle update, post-stress; JAX fori_loop follows same call order. Non-JIT collects intermediate states, JIT returns final arrays and optional writer callbacks. This reading does not inspect constitutive or transfer kernels or prove differentiation accuracy.

name: fabricix/MPM-Py
reading_scope: Bounded code reading; no full audit/build/benchmark
finding: Explicit MPM orchestration distinguishes USF, USL and MUSL stress-update ordering; MUSL remaps momentum. First iteration updates nodal momentum and particle velocity with dt/2, positions with dt; boundary condition hardcodes first element first node. Inner constitutive/transfer kernels were not read.
